texts.name: Bianne
texts.biography: Bianne has always been considered a genius. She was repairing automation systems at only 13 years old. It makes sense that now she's working on the most sophisticated machine in the factory.

specialty.name: Dreadnoughts
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of allied Dreadnoughts, Juggernauts and Onslaughts by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
